meta.name: Rishta com
meta.description:
The story of two contrasting individuals, Isha and Rahul, open a matrimonial agency and try to unite the matches made in heaven, on earth. But while accomplishing the most challenging job, they encounter extreme cases, and illogical requests of their clients.

Rated TV-14 · Ended · First aired 3 Jan 2010 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: YRF Television · Network: YouTube, Sony Entertainment Television

Complete series. On your server: S1 26/26

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Rohit Gupta and Mr. Haldiram's Strange Requests For Marriage
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha are polar opposites running a matrimonial agency together, and deal with illogical requests from their clients in very different ways. Rohit Gupta and Mr Haldiram come to the agency.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha Encounter a Very Difficult Client
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha meet a very difficult client who wants a husband who is richer, more handsome, and generally better than her best friend's groom-to-be.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha's Old Friend Searches For a Perfect Match
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha's old friend from university, Gaurav, becomes a client of Rishta.com as he is in search of a bride. Rohan and Isha work hard to find the best match for him.

videos.title: Isha and Rohan are Dealing With a Very Peculiar Case
videos.overview: Rishta.com's new client is a successful, good-natured man, but at 150 centimetres tall he faces a lot of rejection.

videos.title: Isha and Rohan's New Client is a Very Demanding and a Orthodox Father
videos.overview: Isha and Rohan's new client is an orthodox father who wants the family tradition of choosing a groom for the girl to continue, so he does not bring his daughter along to the Rishta.com office.

videos.title: Double Trouble For Rohan and Isha
videos.overview: Rohan's childhood best friend Akshat is being forced by his family to get married, so he comes to Rishta.com and Isha finds out that he is gay. Stuntman Niel is looking for a wife who will take care of the household.

videos.title: Sameer Malik Shares His Unique Problem With Rohan and Isha
videos.overview: Sameer Malik, a former client of Rishta.com, left the girls that Isha and Rohan matched him with for petty reasons. He returns with a request to meet Sunaina Lal again, as he realises his mistake and wants to marry her.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha have Got a New Client Who is a Old Widow
videos.overview: Mr Halidaram, an old widower, gets potential matches who are younger than him, but things do not seem to work out until Avinash Bansall, the CEO of Shaadi Plus, comes to the rescue.

videos.title: New Client At Rishta.com is Misha Who is a Divorcee and Also a Single Mother
videos.overview: Misha, a divorcee and single mother, finds it hard to face life all by herself and comes to the Rishta.com office to find a life partner who will love and support her.

videos.title: The New Client At Rishta.com is Bar Dancer
videos.overview: Isha and Rohan's latest client is a bar dancer, and it is very difficult to find a suitable match for her.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha's Fourth Couple That They Helped to Get Married are Having a Divorce
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha attempt to save a marriage. Maitri worries that Uday may reject her after their third meeting.

videos.title: Kargil War Army Personnel is Afraid Of Getting a Perfect Match
videos.overview: An army officer who fought in the Kargil War is afraid that he will not be able to get married because he lost a leg in combat. Isha and Rohan work to help him get over his fear.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha Encounter a New Client Who is a Lawyer
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha's new client is a lawyer who is very intelligent, but is very shy around women and has trouble approaching them.

videos.title: Rohan Forgets a Frustrated Business Man Niel's Case
videos.overview: Rishta.com does not find a single match for a businessman when Rohan forgets about his case for six months. A couple in love seek Isha and Rohan's help with their conservative families.

videos.title: An Astrologer In Rishta.com
videos.overview: Kiran and Gaurav met through Rishta.com, but Kiran suddenly calls off their engagement. Isha and Rohan get a new client who can predict the future, and says she was called to their office.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha Get Another Interesting Case
videos.overview: A divorced couple registers at Rishta.com to find matches for themselves, but both turn out to be very difficult, with impossibly specific criteria that they look for in their partners.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha's New Clients are One Divorced Couple
videos.overview: The search for Jui Anand and Akshay Dwivedi's partners still continues, as they never want to take things further with their matches even when the dates go well.

videos.title: Wife Wants a Husband to Get Married Again
videos.overview: Isha and Rohan meet a Muslim couple who are searching for a second wife, as the first wife has been unable to conceive a baby.

videos.title: Husna Gets Confused Between The 2 Prospective Men
videos.overview: Rishta.com's new client, Husna, is confused and fickle-minded, and finds she is unable to decide between two prospective men.

videos.title: Isha and Rohan are Trying to Find a Suitable Partner For Gunja
videos.overview: Isha and Rohan try to find a suitable date for Gunjan's prom night. Both Rohan and Gaurav try to impress an attractive girl in college.

videos.title: 41 Year Old Rich Businessman is Searching For a Pefect Match
videos.overview: Isha and Rohan have to find a compatible partner for a 41-year-old businessman who is not too keen to get married, but agrees to do so at his mother's insistence.

videos.title: Rohan and Isha are Gearing Up to Find a Match For Mona Wazir
videos.overview: India Marriages approach Rishta.com with an interesting offer, as the team gear up to find a match for renowned actress Mona Wazir.

videos.title: Are Roshan and Sharaddha Perfect Match For Each Other
videos.overview: Roshan and Sharaddha, who met through Rishta.com, are having a great time and seem like a perfect match for each other. Sunil, another client, is looking for a match for himself.

videos.title: Rishta.com is Offered a Very Nice Business Proposal From Indian Marriages
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha consider whether they should accept the business proposal from India Marriages. Things are not going well between Vaibhav and Sapna.

videos.title: Heating Argument Between Rohan and Isha
videos.overview: Rohan and Isha have a very bad argument that leads to stress and tension between them, and affects their relationship.

videos.title: Rohan has Left Rishta.com For India Marriages
videos.overview: When Rohan leaves Rishta.com for India Marriages, Isha is very upset and very lonely. Rohan finds it difficult to fit in at his new job.
